name: Meet Craig · The person behind Vegan Masala
objective: Introduce Craig as the founder of Vegan Masala, strengthen trust and encourage people to follow the brand and explore the website.
audience: Existing followers and new visitors interested in vegan food, Indian home cooking and practical recipes.

formats.facebook: Five-image post using the same carousel artwork

carousel.title: Hello, I’m Craig
carousel.body: Founder, home cook and lifelong curry enthusiast.
carousel.visual: Warm waist-up portrait in the Vegan Masala apron, looking directly at the camera.
carousel.altText: Craig Logue, founder of Vegan Masala, standing in his kitchen wearing a Vegan Masala apron.

carousel.title: A love of Indian cooking
carousel.body: Family recipes, treasured takeaways and a Madhur Jaffrey cookbook inspired me to start cooking my favourite dishes at home.
carousel.visual: Craig with a spice tin, cookbook or ingredients in a real kitchen environment.
carousel.altText: Craig preparing spices in his home kitchen.

carousel.title: Plant-based, without compromise
carousel.body: I adapt the curries I love so vegans, vegetarians and curious cooks can enjoy generous Indian food without meat or dairy.
carousel.visual: Craig holding a finished curry or standing beside a freshly cooked dish.
carousel.altText: Craig presenting a homemade vegan Indian curry.

carousel.title: More time in the kitchen
carousel.body: Original cooking videos, practical techniques, ingredient guides and more of the stories behind the food are coming next.
carousel.visual: Natural cooking-action photograph: stirring, tempering spices or rolling bread.
carousel.altText: Craig cooking vegan Indian food at the hob.

carousel.title: Vegan food, cooked with love
carousel.body: Follow Vegan Masala and explore the recipes at vegan-masala.com
carousel.visual: Logo-led closing frame with a smaller relaxed portrait and clear website address.
carousel.altText: Vegan Masala logo, Craig and an invitation to follow and explore the recipes.

stories.title: Hello, I’m Craig
stories.body: The home cook behind Vegan Masala.
stories.visual: Full-height portrait with a restrained gold frame.

stories.title: Why I created Vegan Masala
stories.body: To share generous plant-based Indian food without compromising on flavour.
stories.visual: Cooking-action image or portrait beside a finished dish.

stories.title: Read my story
stories.body: Recipes, techniques and more original cooking are on the way.

requiredAssets: One uncropped high-resolution waist-up portrait in the Vegan Masala apron
One landscape version of the portrait with negative space for text
Optional portrait holding a finished curry or spice tin

brandRules.logo: Use the official Vegan Masala logo without redrawing it
brandRules.imageTreatment: Warm, natural, lightly edited photography with rounded gold borders
brandRules.background: Use the familiar visible mandala texture; avoid flat black empty space
brandRules.text: Keep copy concise, specific and written in Craig’s first-person voice
brandRules.safety: Keep text and faces away from platform interface areas and crop boundaries

approvalNotes: Do not render, schedule or publish until Craig supplies and approves the photographs and the completed artwork.
